entries.wording: Objeto entregue ao destinatário
Inconsistências no endereçamento do objeto
Saída para entrega cancelada
Objeto saiu para entrega ao destinatário
Objeto em transferência - por favor aguarde
Objeto em transferência - por favor aguarde
Saída do Centro Internacional
Objeto recebido na unidade de exportação no país de origem
entries.note: The sending post's office of exchange, before the flight to Brazil.

entries.wording: Objeto recebido pelos Correios do Brasil
entries.note: An item from abroad arriving in Brazil, after the sending post has accepted and dispatched it.

entries.wording: Objeto postado
Análise concluída - importação autorizada
Informações enviadas para análise da autoridade aduaneira/órgãos anuentes
Necessidade de informar CPF/CNPJ do destinatário
entries.note: The import waits for the recipient's tax number (CPF or CNPJ) before customs can clear it.

entries.wording: Objeto em processo de identificação do código de classificação do produto
entries.note: The import waits for customs to settle the product's classification code, after Correios received the item.

entries.wording: Informações prestadas pelo cliente em análise
entries.note: The recipient's answer to customs, such as the tax number FC/16 asks for, under review: the import is still held.

entries.wording: Importação autorizada pela autoridade competente - aguardando pagamento
entries.note: Customs authorized the import and its taxes or fee are due; Correios's import guide holds it until the recipient pays them.

entries.wording: Pagamento confirmado
entries.note: The recipient paid the import's taxes or fee after PAR/17, and the item leaves customs for delivery (https://www.nomadglobal.com/conteudos/minhas-importacoes-correio).

entries.wording: Objeto entregue ao destinatário
Objeto não entregue - cliente mudou-se
Objeto não entregue - carteiro não atendido
Objeto não entregue - carteiro não atendido
entries.note: The postman found nobody to take the item.

entries.wording: Objeto não entregue - carteiro não atendido
entries.note: The same wording as BDE/02, recorded by another unit.

entries.wording: Fiscalização aduaneira finalizada no país de destino
entries.note: Customs in Brazil finished its inspection; the item goes on to delivery.

entries.wording: Objeto não entregue - Endereço inexistente
entries.note: Listed after the item went out for delivery: the postman found no such address.

entries.wording: Objeto não entregue - cliente desconhecido no local
entries.note: Listed after the item went out for delivery: nobody at the address knew the recipient.

entries.wording: Objeto não entregue - endereço incorreto
entries.note: Listed by a unit between transfers, before any delivery run: an address problem rather than an attempt; transfers can follow.

entries.wording: Objeto entregue ao remetente
entries.note: Delivered back to the sender.

entries.wording: Importação não autorizada
entries.note: Customs refused the import.

entries.wording: Objeto não entregue - Endereço insuficiente
entries.note: On the delivery run: the address was too incomplete to deliver to. The item went back into transfer for a route correction.

entries.wording: Favor desconsiderar a informação anterior
entries.note: Correios withdrawing the scan before it, here a cancelled delivery run a second earlier; the run's outcome followed within the hour. No step of its own, so it keeps the stage of the scan before it.

entries.wording: Prazo de regularização encerrado
entries.note: The time to settle the import with customs ran out.

entries.wording: Objeto saiu para entrega ao remetente
entries.note: Out for delivery back to the sender, not to the recipient.

entries.wording: Objeto aguardando retirada no endereço indicado
entries.note: Waiting for collection at the address the scan gives (Endereço); Correios's tracking guide tells the recipient to fetch the item from a Correios unit (https://ecommerce2.tecnomotor.com.br/ecommerce/php-sigep-master/manual/2017-05-02-Guia_Tecnico_Rastreamento_XML_Cliente-Versao_e-commerce.pdf).

entries.wording: Objeto aguardando retirada na Caixa Postal
Objeto aguardando retirada no endereço indicado
entries.note: Another subtype of LDI/01's wording: waiting for collection at the address the scan gives.

entries.wording: Etiqueta emitida
entries.note: A label was issued; Correios does not have the parcel yet.

entries.wording: Direcionado para entrega em unidade dos Correios a pedido do cliente
entries.note: Sent on to a Correios unit, where the recipient asked to collect the item; the wait for collection follows.

entries.wording: Objeto em correção de rota
entries.note: A missorted item that Correios will forward again; transfers follow.

entries.wording: Objeto com conteúdo restrito ou tem limitação de transporte aéreo
entries.note: Content that is restricted or cannot go by air, listed at the minute of a route correction (FC/03): the item goes on by another route, and transfers and the delivery follow.

entries.wording: Objeto postado após o horário limite da unidade
entries.note: Posted after the counter's cut-off time.

entries.wording: Devolução determinada pela autoridade competente
entries.note: Customs ordered the parcel back to its sender.

entries.wording: Objeto encaminhado para fiscalização aduaneira de exportação
entries.note: An item posted for abroad sent to export customs inspection, after its posting and before a transfer; while it is there Correios does not hold it (https://www.fazcomex.com.br/npe/objeto-encaminhado-para-fiscalizacao-aduaneira-de-exportacao/).

entries.wording: Aguardando pagamento
entries.note: Correios's import guide: the tracker shows this while taxes or Correios's despacho postal fee are due, and the import is not released until the recipient pays them in Minhas Importações (https://www.correios.com.br/receber/encomenda/arquivos/internacional/como-importar-pelos-correios-2024-1.pdf). Its code is not recorded, so the wording stages the scan.

entries.wording: Objeto recebido em
entries.note: Received at a unit along the way, after export inspection and a transfer; the reply gave no unit address, so the place is missing from the wording too.
